history: always-repro'd across v1.6.2104..v1.9.2607 (18 releases, linear scan); v1.4.1907 and v1.5.2010 answer "invalid profile lib_6_6" and are invalid probes. A compute translation of the same construct shows the same front-end silence in v1.4.1907, where the resulting out-of-bounds read was still rejected by the DXIL validator; from v1.5.2010 on the index is undef and validation passes.
reviewed_by: gpt-5.6-sol (independent draft review, SKILL.md step 10, applied selectively at collation)
summary: Still reproduces on main (1.9.0.5433, 13730886e) and on every release back to v1.6.2104: DXC has the "vector element index out of bounds" error but never reaches it when the subscript is the index operand of another subscript, so the element becomes undef and is used as a buffer index. FXC has no raytracing profile, so the cross-compiler comparison used a compute restating of the same construct; FXC rejects that with X3504, while clang-dxc trunk misses this form and also the plain form DXC catches. Arrays have the identical hole (g_vertices[a[3]] silent, uint x = a[3] diagnosed).
title: Vector element index out-of-bounds not leading to compile error
